attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (GUI) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The binary is a launcher for the Windows Calculator application. Its primary function, observed in wWinMain, is to call ShellExecuteW with the URI 'ms-calculator:', which is the standard method for starting the modern UWP Calculator app. The program also logs an ETW event 'CalculatorStarted', which is consistent with legitimate application behavior. The embedded manifest strings further identify it as 'Microsoft.Windows.Shell.calc'. No malicious activities are present.
